title: Homilies on Ezekiel, Homilia VI
blurb: Origen’s Homilia VI on Ezekiel (Jerome’s Latin). Complete on this page: §§1–2.
first_english_note: Original English Translation of Origen’s Homilia VI on Ezekiel — no previous public-domain English (ANF lacks these homilies; Scheck FOTC is copyrighted and was not used as wording). This page is Homilia VI §§1–2 (closeout). The English here is new.

text_history.method: English follows Baehrens, Origenes Werke VIII = GCS 33 (1925). Scheck FOTC was not used as wording. This page is Homilia VI §§1–2 (closeout).
